newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss sight deposits rise to 3,241.6 million Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss sight deposits rise to 3,241.6 million Sfr.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank said sight deposits rose 49.0 million Swiss francs to 3,241.6 million in the reporting period ended October 31.
Statement of November 1 in millions of Swiss francs:

Borrowing at the emergency Lombard window fell by 0.4 million francs to 1.3 million in the reporting period. Outstanding borrowing via the discount facility and swaps of money market certificates rose by 538.6 million francs to 1,852.6 million.
An SNB spokesman that the increase in sight deposits reflected mainly the increase in notes in circulation, which he said was tied to normal month-end activity.
